   123:   kubernetes.core.k8s_exec:
   124:     namespace: "{{ backup_pvc_namespace }}"
   125:     pod: "{{ ansible_operator_meta.name }}-db-management"
   126:     command: |
   127:       bash -c "
   128:       function end_keepalive {
   129:         rc=$?
   130:         rm -f \"$1\"
   131:         kill $(cat /proc/$2/task/$2/children 2>/dev/null) 2>/dev/null || true
   132:         wait $2 || true
   133:         exit $rc
   134:       }
   135:       keepalive_file=\"$(mktemp)\"
   136:       until {{ pg_isready }} &> /dev/null
   137:       do
   138:           echo \"Waiting until Postgres is accepting connections...\"
   139:           sleep 2
   140:       done
   141:       while [[ -f \"$keepalive_file\" ]]; do
   142:         echo 'Migrating data from old database...'
   143:         sleep 60
   144:       done &
   145:       keepalive_pid=$!
   146:       trap 'end_keepalive \"$keepalive_file\" \"$keepalive_pid\"' EXIT SIGINT SIGTERM
   147:       echo keepalive_pid: $keepalive_pid
   148:       set -e -o pipefail
   149:       {{ pg_drop_create }}
   150:       set +H  # Disable history expansion
   151:       cat {{ backup_dir }}/pulp.db | PGPASSWORD='{{ postgres_pass }}' {{ pg_restore }}
   152:       set -H  # Re-enable history expansion
   153:       PG_RC=$?
   154:       set +e +o pipefail
   155:       exit $PG_RC
   156:       "
   157:   register: data_migration
   158:   no_log: "{{ no_log }}"

   160: - name: Revoke CREATEDB privilege from database user
   161:   kubernetes.core.k8s_exec:
   162:     namespace: "{{ ansible_operator_meta.namespace }}"
   163:     pod: "{{ postgres_pod_name }}"
   164:     container: postgres
   165:     command: >-
   166:       psql -c "ALTER USER {{ postgres_user }} NOCREATEDB;"

   168:     - force_drop_db | bool
   169:     - postgres_type == 'managed'
